abi.local_version_convention: <public_version>+cu<var>torch2.13.glibc239 (torch-linked packages); +cu<var>.glibc239 (torch itself and onnxruntime-gpu, which link CUDA but are not compiled against an external torch). <var> is one of cuda_variants (13.3 | 13.0). Wheel filenames carry the local segment; release tags are <pkg>-v<public>-cu<var> (no +local, and always variant-suffixed so the two trains never collide). The cu13.3 literals in this file are the canonical defaults; cu13.0 wheels/tags are produced by token substitution at build/index time.

packages.name: triton
packages.arch_target: aarch64 (CUDA PTX JIT, no arch pin)
packages.notes: Pinned to the exact commit PyTorch 2.13.0 expects (see pytorch/.ci/docker/ci_commit_pins/triton.txt). Triton downloads its own pinned prebuilt LLVM during the build; no system LLVM package is needed. Version 3.7.1, 1 commit ahead of the v3.7.1 release tag (cherry-pick for async fence fix).

packages.name: torch
packages.notes: PyTorch 2.13.0 already has native sm_121a support in cmake/Codegen.cmake (gated on CUDA >= 12.9). No patch needed -- the dgx_spark_config/pytorch.patch was for 2.9.x. Built from source with USE_CUDNN/USE_CUSPARSELT/USE_CUFILE/USE_SYSTEM_TRITON/USE_SYSTEM_NCCL=1. Depends on triton wheel.

packages.name: torchaudio
packages.notes: Pinned to main (SHA 4e3e282b) because upstream has not cut a v2.13.0 release tag; latest release is v2.11.0. The main branch version.txt is 2.11.0a0; we stamp 2.11.0 (BUILD_VERSION overwrites version.txt). Tracks pytorch main (2.13.0+) and should be ABI-compatible. Depends on the from-source torch wheel.

packages.name: torchvision
packages.notes: Pinned to tag v0.28.0 (companion release for torch 2.13.0). Depends on the from-source torch wheel.

packages.name: flash-attn
packages.notes: Narrowed to GB10-only build. Do not raise MAX_JOBS above ~4-8 without watching free -h; flash_bwd_hdim256_*_sm80 backward kernels are the OOM failure mode. Rebuilt against: triton (wheel) + torch (from-source cu13.3).

packages.name: sageattention
packages.notes: Small extension set, builds in well under a minute. Rebuilt against: triton (wheel) + torch (from-source cu13.3).

packages.name: sageattn3
packages.notes: setup.py probes the live GPU's compute capability; no arch env var needed. Fast build (2 extensions). Requires --gpus all at build time. Rebuilt against: triton (wheel) + torch (from-source cu13.3).

packages.name: nunchaku
packages.notes: --gpus all required at build time; setup.py probes the live GPU to select sm_121a. Rebuilt against: triton (wheel) + torch (from-source cu13.3).

packages.name: onnxruntime-gpu
packages.notes: Fork carries CUDA-13/aarch64 build-compatibility patches (cub/thrust compat, CUTLASS version-check) applied automatically at configure time; no manual patching needed. Rebuilt with --cuda_version 13.3.

packages.name: flashinfer-python
packages.notes: Distribution name is flashinfer-python (upstream's JIT package). Pure-Python wheel, tagged py3-none-any (NOT cp312-linux_aarch64): custom PEP 517 build_backend.py -- kernels compile at runtime via cutlass-dsl + tvm-ffi, so there is no compiled extension at install time and setuptools marks the wheel root-is-pure. The +cu<variant>torch2.13.glibc239 local segment still records the environment it was built/verified against (the JIT-compiled kernels link glibc at runtime). The JIT kernel headers (cccl, cutlass, spdlog) are vendored from git submodules into flashinfer/data/* -- the build MUST run git submodule update --init --recursive, or the wheel ships empty data dirs and the runtime JIT falls back to the CTK CCCL (missing cuda::fast_mod_div, upstream issue #3159). flashinfer-cubin is NOT built: upstream artifactory has no sm_120/sm_121 cubins (only sm_100a/103a/110a), so it would publish an empty/broken package on GB10. Built with BUILD_NVEP=0 (skips the nvcc/meson/UCX moe_ep backends) and --no-build-isolation --no-deps. Verify installs the nvidia-cutlass-dsl[cu13] extra (the base requirements pull cu12 libs by default; GB10 needs cu13). Needs the from-source torch at build AND runtime.

packages.name: mamba-ssm
packages.arch_target: sm_121 (compiled selective_scan_cuda; setup.py gencodes sm_75..sm_121 when nvcc >= 13.0)
packages.notes: One compiled CUDA extension (selective_scan_cuda) built via torch.utils.cpp_extension; setup.py's gencode list includes sm_121 for nvcc >= 13.0, so no arch patch needed. MAMBA_FORCE_BUILD=TRUE disables setup.py's prebuilt-wheel download shortcut (CachedWheelsCommand). Runtime deps (tilelang==0.1.8, quack-kernels>=0.3.4, transformers, apache-tvm-ffi<=0.1.9, triton>=3.5.0, einops) all have aarch64 wheels; causal_conv1d is commented out upstream (replaced by tilelang/quack-kernels in the 2.3.x line). torch-linked package -- needs the from-source torch at build AND runtime.

packages.name: causal-conv1d
packages.arch_target: sm_121 (compiled causal_conv1d_cuda; setup.py gencodes sm_75..sm_121 when nvcc >= 13.0)
packages.notes: One compiled CUDA extension (causal_conv1d_cuda) built via torch.utils.cpp_extension; setup.py's gencode list includes sm_121 for nvcc >= 13.0. CAUSAL_CONV1D_FORCE_BUILD=TRUE skips the prebuilt-wheel download shortcut (CachedWheelsCommand — Dao-AILab publishes zero binary wheels, source-only on PyPI). Minimal install_requires (torch, packaging, ninja); no triton or submodule deps. Critical runtime dep of mamba-ssm (Mamba v1 conv1d + v2 SSD fast paths); mamba-ssm comments it out of install_requires but imports it everywhere. torch-linked package.

packages.name: nixl
packages.notes: GB10-specific nixl wheel built with UCX, libfabric, POSIX, OBJ and Mooncake plugins, CUDA sm_121, and the nixl_ep EP extension (build_nixl_ep=true, requires sm_90+). The pyproject.toml is patched at build time to nixl-cu13 / torch==2.13.*. The Python package is a consumer of torch but does not compile against the torch C++ API, hence the +cu<variant>.glibc239 local segment. Built in two stages: build-nixl-images.yml constructs the nixl-runtime and nixl-wheel-builder Docker images — the Dockerfile is self-contained, cloning nixl (ai-dynamo/nixl at b0cbb23), UCX (openucx/ucx at 7a5e80f), and Mooncake (kvcache-ai/Mooncake at v0.3.12.post1) directly via git at pinned refs — then build-wheel.yml extracts the wheel from the wheel-builder image, injects the local version segment, and verifies it inside the nixl-runtime image. The wheel includes both nixl_cu13 (core API) and nixl_ep_cu13 (EP extension for all2all expert-parallel communication). Integrated into build-all.yml as Phase 0 (images) + Phase 5 (wheel).

packages.name: uccl
packages.notes: EP-only build (BUILD_TYPE=ep). torch-linked (CUDAExtension links libtorch). Needs RDMA dev libs (libibverbs-dev, libnl-3-dev, libnl-route-3-dev, libnuma-dev) + nanobind at build time, installed via apt/pip in the build script. Built with TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.1, no EFA, no Intel RDMA NIC, no DMA-BUF. At runtime the EP probes whether the GPU scratch buffer can be registered for RDMA; when it cannot (GB10 without nvidia_peermem), it automatically allocates a pinned-host scratch buffer and the CPU proxy threads perform ibv_reg_mr on host memory. The uccl top-level setup.py packages the uccl/ Python module with the compiled ep.abi3.so as package_data. The fork carries THREE source patches (commit 21a5606c): (1) ep/bench/buffer.py is extended to accept vLLM's DeepEP all2all API surface (enable_shrink kwarg, low_latency_query_mask_buffer/low_latency_clean_mask_buffer, use_nvfp4/x_global_scale dispatch kwargs) so the deep_ep wrapper is a true drop-in for vLLM's deepep_low_latency backend. (2) ep/src/internode_ll.cu kNumMaxTopK bumped 16→24 in both dispatch and combine kernels to handle Nemotron-3 Super's num_experts_per_tok=22. (3) Warp group fallback for low-SM devices: when ceil_div(num_experts, num_device_sms) produces too few warp groups (GB10 48 SMs, 512 global experts from vLLM), cap at 14 for dispatch (< 15 device assert) and 15 for combine (< 16 device assert). Depends on the from-source torch at build AND runtime. cu13.3-only (sm_121-specific).

packages.name: deep-ep
packages.notes: Pure-Python drop-in replacement for DeepSeek's deep_ep package. Imports uccl.ep (the compiled EP extension). Provides the same Buffer API as DeepEP for vLLM's --all2all-backend deepep_{low_latency,high_throughput}. check_nvlink_connections is a no-op on GB10 (device name does not contain 'PCIE'), so UCCL EP works on single-GPU-per-node GB10 where original DeepEP cannot (DeepEP requires NVLink for intranode ranks). Depends on uccl (runtime) + the from-source torch (runtime). cu13.3-only.
